description: C4, keyed units that die NOT carried, on Show Down. v: an ATLAS loads TXBIG (TXCOM1's keys, MaxDamage 32000) at (800, 700); once it is aboard (its +0x86 names the ATLAS), `tacli order --unit N --expect ARMATLAS move pos 800 1600` flies it toward v_gun, the AI's TXRL (TX_AA: 1000 to the ATLAS, 1 to a commander), which downs it; the cargo loop's 30 000 leaves TXBIG 2000 HP, not dying, so it is not marked. It lands; `tacli scenario apply` of a TXLLT2 of the AI's beside it (TX_LAS2: 65 000 to a commander) kills it on the ground: not carried, stock's COMMANDER_BLAST, and no `decided carried` in the log. f: TXCOM1 at (4300, 1600) with no transport, beside f_gun, the AI's TXLLT2 (range 200), which kills it at once: not carried, stock's COMMANDER_BLAST. Each ring is two unarmed CORKROGs (29 918 HP) 260 either side of the load site: read their HP (+0x108) before and after. TX_BLAST_E takes 111 and TX_BLAST_S 222 from anywhere within 2000; stock's COMMANDER_BLAST takes thousands within 950. The cases are 3500 apart. Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into the instance's gamedir.
